hazards.control: Only qualified people at the drive, transformer, and junction box; lockout before cable work.

name: Variable speed drive, transformer, and junction box
function: The surface electrical package: the drive that sets the motor frequency, the transformer that steps its output to the motor voltage, and the vented junction box where the well cable meets the surface cable.

tabs.overview: The drive starts the motor softly and trims the rate; the junction box vents gas that migrates up the cable so it never reaches the drive.
tabs.engineering: Drive sized to the motor current; transformer to the cable voltage.
tabs.safety: High voltage; the junction box is never sealed.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
